facts.text: Regesto describes support through host capabilities rather than a closed list of agent vendors.
The published support levels are core access, portable discovery, deterministic context injection, optional native-memory harvest, and manual import.
The live instance is manually updated to integrations; historical config and state layouts have no automatic migration layer.
New configuration may declare an arbitrary integration and its capabilities without changing Go code for portable capabilities.
Built-in integration profiles are data-driven, validated at startup, and contain no personal paths.
Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes remain built-in profiles and retain their current configuration identifiers.
Hermes is documented and tested as a working integration, including first-turn context and channel-dependent trust.
Shared Agent Skills conform to the portable Agent Skills contract and contain no required vendor-specific syntax.
Host-specific skill optimizations never leak into another host's rendered skill.
Regesto exposes a validated machine-facing write command.
Machine-facing commands have stable JSON forms.
Adapter installation is implemented in tested Go code and the existing installer path remains a thin launcher.
Installation is dry-run safe, idempotent, backup-aware, shared-target-aware, and ownership-safe.
Hook protocols and registration belong to integration profiles.
Claude SessionStart behavior remains project-aware and fail-open.
Hermes first-turn behavior remains once-per-session, correctly encoded, and fail-open.
Codex remains a portable skills-and-instructions integration.
A configured custom integration works for paths and optional Markdown memory without a source change.
Unknown and unattended sources quarantine by default and trust is policy-driven.
Existing trusted_sources entries retain their meaning.
Markdown memory is optional and unsupported memory-store kinds are reported explicitly.
A local stdio MCP server exposes core capabilities without a network listener.
Manual promotion documentation applies to any inaccessible chat/app host.
regesto doctor reports integration health and remediation.
Init, upgrade, and manifest safety cover integration-owned files.
Documentation has a canonical capability matrix and separate product recipes.
The automated suite covers contracts, current-format safety, protocols, trust, MCP, custom integrations, and packaging.
Manual end-to-end tests pass for Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes.
Remote services, proprietary cloud-memory connectors, and every vendor preset are outside this goal.
The existing fact-file schema and source syntax remain valid.
